messages.text:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for clarifying the warranty terms and the actual firmware modes.

However, this clarification highlights another discrepancy. Prior to my purchase, the advertised hash rates and their corresponding power requirements were explicitly listed as:
Eco: 30 TH/s @ 450W
Standard: 40 TH/s @ 650W
Turbo: 50 TH/s @ 850W

Since you have confirmed the actual firmware modes are 30 TH/s, 36 TH/s, and 42 TH/s, I need to know exactly how this affects the wattage.
Please provide the specific power draw (in watts) for each of these three updated modes so I can accurately assess the electrical load for my infrastructure.

Regards,

Larry D.
The Node Runner LLC
Handed to the team · Per-mode wattage is not in our product facts; won't guess a spec for an infrastr

Note to the team: I passed this to JD as a technical question and drafted your reply to Larry. I didn't give him any wattage figures, because we don't have the power draw for each mode on record and the product listing wouldn't load for me to check. The draft sends him to Discord as well as promis…
